card.name: Women's first names, mid-name
card.fires_on: The last piece of a woman's first name, or the first name itself, just before her surname or middle initial. It appears in credited quotes, bylines, news and biographies.

modes.label: Ending of a female first name
modes.description: The final piece of a longer woman's name, right before the surname.
modes.example: Ed<<ith>> Flanigen is deservedly a living

modes.label: Whole female first name before surname
modes.description: A complete woman's first name that comes just before a surname.
modes.example: The<< Barbara>> Bush Foundation for Family Literacy 1

card.writes: It pushes toward female-related words such as women, wife, husband, menstruation, skirt and Ms., and away from male terms.
card.plain: It spots a woman's first name being spelled out and prepares the text for female-related words.
